¿Puedo usar mis extensiones de Chrome?: Can I use my Chrome extensions?
Muchas, sí: scripts y estilos de página,: Many of them, yes: page scripts and styles, background pages, popups, options, storage and static blocking rules. There is no webRequest, context menus or cookies yet, so some will not work.
¿Por qué usa WebKit y no Chromium?: Why does it use WebKit and not Chromium?
WebKitGTK es ligero, se integra con GTK: WebKitGTK is light, integrates with GTK and comes with tracking protection. Brújula adds its own blocker and extension support on top.
¿Tiene gestor de contraseñas, historial: Does it have a password manager, history or private mode?
Todavía no. Es la primera versión: esas: Not yet. This is the first release: those features are planned, but they don't exist today.
¿Puedo sincronizar mis marcadores y ajus: Can I sync my bookmarks and settings?
Sí, mediante una carpeta de tu nube (Dro: Yes, through a folder in your cloud storage (Dropbox, Nextcloud, iCloud Drive…) or a Nodalix account.
